from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class CompanyRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for a single company extracted from one document."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock exchange code of the company")
    reporting_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The financial reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")
    total_assets: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total assets value for the period")
    shareholders_equity: Optional[float] = Field(description="Equity attributable to shareholders")
    operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: List[CompanyRecord]
